# netbox_inventory_items (Data Source)

Lists inventory_item objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_inventory_items" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-inventory_item" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: asset_tag, asset_tag__empty, asset_tag__ic, asset_tag__ie, asset_tag__iew, asset_tag__iregex, asset_tag__isw, asset_tag__n, asset_tag__nic, asset_tag__nie, asset_tag__niew, asset_tag__nisw, asset_tag__regex, device_id, device_id__n, discovered, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, label, label__empty, label__ic, label__ie, label__iew, label__iregex, label__isw, label__n, label__nic, label__nie, label__niew, label__nisw, label__regex, manufacturer_id, manufacturer_id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner_id, owner_id__n, parent_id, parent_id__n, role_id, role_id__n, serial, serial__empty, serial__ic, serial__ie, serial__iew, serial__iregex, serial__isw, serial__n, serial__nic, serial__nie, serial__niew, serial__nisw, serial__regex, tag, tag__any, tag__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `inventory_items` (Attributes List) The matching inventory_items. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inventory_items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--inventory_items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inventory_items`

Read-Only:

- `asset_tag` (String) Unique asset tag.
- `component_id` (Number) Id of the device component named by component_type.
- `component_type` (String) Type of the device component the item is bound to, e.g. dcim.interface. Requires component_id.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `discovered` (Boolean) Whether the item was discovered automatically.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `label` (String) Physical label.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `manufacturer_id` (Number) Id of the manufacturer.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `parent_id` (Number) Id of the parent inventory item.
- `part_id` (String) Manufacturer part number.
- `role_id` (Number) Id of the inventory item role.
- `serial` (String) Serial number.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
